// Ensure settings row exists, then update it
    await sql`
      INSERT INTO notification_settings (
        notification_subject_template, notification_body_template,
        quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, timezone, updated_at
      )
      SELECT
        ${safeSubject}, ${safeBody}, '22:00', '08:00', 'America/New_York', now()
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_settings)
    `;
    await sql`
      UPDATE notification_settings
      SET notification_subject_template = ${safeSubject},
          notification_body_template = ${safeBody},
          updated_at = now()
    `;
